review_notes:
I read the whole file. It defines Equiv.map, Equiv.functor, Equiv.traverse and Equiv.traversable, which transfer `Functor` and `Traversable` structure along a family of equivalences `∀ α, t α ≃ t' α`, together with their lawfulness proofs. I searched Mathlib for existing transfer constructions for `Functor` or `Traversable` and found none. The closest candidates are:
- `MvFunctor.ofEquiv` in Mathlib/Control/Functor/Multivariate.lean. It is the same idea for the multivariate `MvFunctor` class over `TypeVec`, so it is a different concept. It has no traversable or lawfulness part and cannot be used to replace `Equiv.functor`.
- `EquivFunctor` in Mathlib/Control/EquivFunctor.lean. It maps equivalences `α ≃ β` to `f α ≃ f β`, which is a different notion from transferring a `Functor` instance.
I also found nothing relevant in the Batteries or Lean core sources I checked. The only real uses are `DList` in Mathlib/Data/DList/Instances.lean and commented-out code in Mathlib/Logic/Equiv/Array.lean. I found no existing concept that duplicates the file's definitions.
